# Sapling & Seeds — llms.txt
# https://www.saplingandseeds.com/

## About
Sapling & Seeds is a premium eco-friendly and sustainable products brand by Shanah Enterprises, based in New Delhi, India. We create plastic-free alternatives for everyday essentials — from oral care to stationery to gifting — crafted from natural bamboo, pure neem wood, and recycled materials.

Our mission: replace single-use plastics with sustainable, beautiful, and functional alternatives. Every product is a step towards a plastic-free world.

## Products & Collections

### Bamboo Oral Care
- Bamboo Toothbrushes (adult and kids sizes)
  - Variants: Charcoal bristles, Fibre bristles
  - Handles: 100% natural bamboo, biodegradable
  - Price: from ₹49

### Neem Wood Hair Care
- Pure Neem Wood Combs — anti-bacterial, anti-dandruff, anti-static
  - Styles: Tail Comb, Pocket Comb, Shampoo Comb, Dual Lily Comb, Ruby Comb
  - Naturally oiled for smooth, static-free use
  - Price: from ₹49
- Tongue Cleaner (stainless steel, plastic-free)

### Eco-Stationery
- Plantable A5 Notebooks — recycled paper covers with embedded wildflower seeds
- Plantable Calendars
- Seed Pencils — plant them when short, they grow into herbs or flowers
- Seed Color Pencils
- Diary with Pen (eco-packaging)
- Pen with Box (recycled/natural materials)

### Bamboo Drinkware & Bottles
- Bamboo Water Bottles — reusable, BPA-free
- Cork Coffee Mugs
- Bamboo Tumblers (styles 1 & 2)

### Sustainable Gifting Sets
- Premium Bamboo Gift Set 1 & 2 — curated for corporate events, weddings, festivals
- Eco Starter Kit — a starter bundle including plastic-free essentials
- Custom-branded corporate gifting available with zero-plastic packaging
- Price: from ₹150
